root.label: Rabies-positive raccoon found in Westlake Village

events.label: Rabies-positive raccoon found in Westlake Village

slots.name: exposed people
slots.sentence: One dog with up-to-date vaccinations and four people at a worksite may have been exposed to the animal and are following up with care.

slots.name: raccoon count
slots.sentence: The Los Angeles County Department of Public Health announced in an Oct. 5 news release that it was investigating a rabies-positive raccoon in Westlake Village, a city on the border of Los Angeles and Ventura counties.

slots.name: last non-bat year
slots.sentence: the last non-bat animal was a skunk in Long Beach in 2014.
